alt_text: Cover: 3 questions, can you score? PSLE-style MCQ.
Question 1: a circuit tester with a gap. Which object makes the bulb light? Options 1 to 4: rubber eraser, steel paper clip, wooden stick, plastic ruler.
Question 2: a circuit with bulb P on one branch and bulb Q with an open switch S on another branch. Which bulbs light?
Question 3: a table of three set-ups with different numbers of batteries and bulbs. Rank the brightness.
Answers: Q1 option 2, steel paper clip. Q2 option 1, P only. Q3 option 2, order 2, 1, 3. Each with the reason.
